title: Israel Is More Isolated Than Ever. Is It Enough to End the Gaza Genocide?
author: Diana Buttu
content:

[Macklemore  
](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdRdsy0m2HK/?hl=en)[Zach Bryan  
](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/zach-bryan-breaks-record-kraft-free-

](https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/see-what-was-done-
gaza-angelina-jolie-shares-image-destruction)Even [Megyn
Kelly](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6nOEDBE0RDc)

Today, Palestine can be seen and heard everywhere. For the first time,
supporting Israel is costly and staying "neutral" is not an option - just ask
Ed Sheeran, whose ticket sales have [plummeted](https://www.newsweek.com/ed-
sheeran-ticket-prices-plunge-after-macklemore-backlash-12461617) for his
mealy-mouthed bothsidesism and "it's complicated" stance. Palestine marches
continue to [attract
thousands](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/28/palestine-action-
protesters-arrested-outside-uk-labour-party-conference), and even in the
United States, [public opinion polls](https://www.pewresearch.org/short-
reads/2026/07/09/americans-views-of-israelis-have-grown-increasingly-negative-
but-views-of-palestinians-have-held-fairly-steady/) are
[showing](https://zeteo.com/p/poll-american-voters-israel-committing-genocide-
gaza) that Israel is not liked - so much so that Megyn Kelly, a woman who,
just a year ago, [said](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/04/gaza-
cafes-starvation-social-media) that we Palestinians were "fine" having our
children starve just so that we "can put them on camera," has begun to change
her tune.

It's not that I couldn't have imagined criticizing Israel publicly - or at the
very least calling for a "free Palestine" - in the West would no longer be
taboo; I just never thought it would take so long and come at such an enormous
cost to Palestinians. In just three years, over [200,000
Palestinians](https://t.me/MOHMediaGaza/7647) have been killed or injured, or
are missing; children are being starved, and [their limbs blown
off](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/8/20/amputee-children-
learn-to-swim-after-losing-limbs-in-israels-war-on-gaza); [Israeli
bombings](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-israeli-settlers-e73)
have not [stopped](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/5/gaza-iran-lebanon-
if-ceasefires-are-in-place-why-do-strikes-continue); and Israel continues to
use Palestinian bodies to
[test](https://www.haaretz.com/opinion/2026-02-24/ty-article-
opinion/.premium/when-israeli-arms-merchants-boast-of-gaza-serving-as-a-lab-
for-human-testing/0000019c-90d4-dab1-adbe-bafebd4e0000) out the latest AI
mass-killing invention.

And while [global public opinion](http://v) has shifted, we still have not
seen this translate into a shift in policy. Bombs are still being [sent to
Israel](https://apnews.com/article/trump-israel-weapons-sales-gaza-
eb48cb7ecf773ffc472fbafc995aef2a); trade is still
[flowing](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/27/countries-denounce-israel-
but-keep-trading-with-it) with Israel (despite proclamations that they will
stop), and Benjamin Netanyahu (and his entire cabinet of war crimes
supporters) is still [roaming
freely](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/canada-france-italy-and-greece-
allow-netanyahus-overflight-despite-icc-arrest-warrant), despite an
International Criminal Court arrest warrant.

Israel continues to speak very openly about ethnic cleansing, not just in Gaza
but in the [West
Bank](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/research/2026/06/israel-west-bank-
ethnic-cleansing/) and in
[Lebanon](https://www.facebook.com/MiddleEastEye/videos/smotrich-says-israels-
thorough-cleansing-in-southern-lebanon-unprecedented/4176795955956622/), and
the Israeli public continues to
[deny](https://blogs.timesofisrael.com/genocide-domicide-and-israels-
mechanism-of-denial-regarding-gaza) (or not care) that it has carried out
genocide. In Gaza, Israel [steals more and more
land](https://arabcenterdc.org/resource/israels-policy-of-irreversible-
occupation/), [kills more Palestinians](https://imeu.org/resources/gaza/fact-
sheet-three-years-of-israels-genocide-of-palestinians-in-gaza/506), and has,
one year into a so-called ceasefire, [not
allowed](https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/08/20/israel-
says-no-gaza-reconstruction-before-hamas-fully-disarms) any reconstruction
material to enter the Strip because it has made clear that it aims to
[ethnically cleanse](https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2026/02/ethnic-
cleansing-concerns-gaza-and-west-bank-amid-intensified-violence-and). It's no
longer a secret - and the global public is catching on, but why haven't the
decision-makers? Why haven't the bomb shipments stopped?
